title: Privacy Policy
descriptionA1:
The NATIONAL DISTANCE EDUCATION UNIVERSITY (hereinafter, UNED) is strongly committed to protecting the personal data of users, especially when they may be minors.
This Privacy Policy aims to clearly and accessibly explain how we process personal data collected through the SafeMountain mobile application, which performs privacy analysis on the apps installed on the user's device.
This app does not access unnecessary or sensitive personal data, nor does it carry out hidden data processing. The detection of installed apps is carried out solely for the purpose of informing users about potential privacy risks associated with their use, and not for commercial purposes, tracking, or profiling.
Any changes to this policy will be communicated in advance through the app itself, so that users can review them and, where applicable, provide explicit consent for any processing that requires it.
If the user is a minor, notices will be adapted to their level of understanding, and, when appropriate, the consent of parents or legal guardians will be requested in accordance with current regulations.
descriptionA2:
Data Controller: NATIONAL DISTANCE EDUCATION UNIVERSITY (UNED)
Address: Calle Bravo Murillo 38, Madrid, 28015
Email: infouned@adm.uned.es
Data Protection Officer (DPO): dpd@adm.uned.es
descriptionA3: The application processes personal data solely to provide privacy analysis functionalities regarding the apps installed on the user's device. Specifically, it collects the list of installed applications to assess potential risks related to excessive permissions, access to sensitive data, or communications with third parties. This information is not used for commercial purposes or for creating user profiles. Under no circumstances does the app access private content such as messages, photos, videos, or contacts. The processing is carried out exclusively to inform and raise user awareness about security and privacy in the use of their device. When the user is a minor, specific enhanced protection measures will apply, and, where applicable, the authorization of a parent or legal guardian will be required for certain functions.
descriptionA4: The processing of personal data by this application is based on various legal grounds depending on the specific use. In general, the main legal basis is the explicit consent of the user, which is clearly requested before accessing the list of installed applications. In the case of minor users, consent will be obtained from their legal representatives when required by applicable law. In certain cases, the processing may also be based on the legitimate interest of the data controller to offer basic security analysis functionalities, always ensuring that users' rights and freedoms are not infringed.
descriptionA5: Personal data collected by the application will be retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purpose for which it was collected, and will then be securely deleted or anonymized. Under no circumstances will information be retained indefinitely, nor will unnecessary data be stored. When the processing is based on the user’s consent, it may be withdrawn at any time, which will result in the deletion of the associated data, unless a legal obligation justifies its retention. The application does not record images or access multimedia content on the device.
descriptionA6: Personal data collected by the application will not be disclosed to third parties under any circumstances, unless there is a legal obligation to do so or explicit consent is obtained from the user. The app does not share information with advertisers, social networks, or external platforms. If it becomes necessary to share data with competent authorities (for example, in the context of a legal investigation), such disclosure will be carried out in accordance with applicable legislation. Under no circumstances will personal data be sold or transferred to third parties for advertising or profiling purposes.
descriptionA7:
Users have the right to withdraw their consent for data processing at any time. They may exercise their rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and objection to processing by contacting the UNED Data Protection Office, at Calle Bravo Murillo 38, 28015 Madrid, or at any official assistance office, using the additional information and form available at the Data Protection Office (www.uned.es/dpj) or via the UNED Electronic Headquarters (https://sede.uned.es/procedimientos/portada/idp/40).
Likewise, users have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es) if they believe their rights have not been adequately respected.
descriptionA8:
UNED applies appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data collected through the SafeMountain app. These measures include encryption, restricted access to authorized personnel only, and secure data storage.

The app does not use cookies or equivalent tracking technologies. Data is not transferred to third parties, is not stored in the cloud, and remains on the device unless the user explicitly consents to its transmission to the analysis platform within the project framework.

SafeMountain is designed following the principle of 'privacy by design', minimizing data collection and always offering the user the ability to review and control the information processed.
